verdict.rationale: GoDaddy provides machine-readable OpenAPI specs for Domains, Commerce, Orders, Stores, etc., and an end-to-end workflow doc with curl + Node + Python + Go examples, which supports building integrations in multiple languages, but there's no explicit evidence of officially published, versioned SDK packages (e.g., npm/pip client libraries) beyond generated-from-spec code samples. missing for 10: dedicated official SDK packages/libraries with versioning and package-manager distribution, independent developer confirmation of SDK usage.
